scope: The extant 1889 Brisbane Customs House exterior, including the mapped apsidal Long Room, copper dome and lantern, Queen Street stone portico, and the lower masonry level on the Brisbane River side.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The University of Queensland identifies two Queen Street storeys, three river storeys, Free Classical portico and colonnades, and the copper dome over the Long Room.
The owner identifies the copper replacement completed in November 2024 and the retained dome ornaments, lantern windows and flagpoles.
The local heritage inventory identifies the 1889 Customs House and distinct 1881 retaining wall and surrounding precinct structures.

next: Model the stepped masonry wings, Queen Street colonnade and pediments, curved northeast end, drum, ribs and lantern. Set the river basement from the original government elevation field.
